subject: Request: accelerated vesting + sign-on bridge approval for Sr. Inference candidate
messages:
From: Samantha Blake <samantha@talentmatch.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate acceptance — request for sign-on + accelerated vesting

Hi Marcus —

Quick update: Arjun Rao (final stage Sr. Inference) verbally accepted the verbal offer this morning and is asking for a small bridge package to make the transition work. He has another in-flight offer with an earlier start expectation; this is time sensitive (would like to close by end of week).

Request details from candidate:
- $20,000 one-time sign-on (gross)
- Early vesting: 25% of the grant vest at start (one-time upfront) then standard schedule thereafter
- $5,000 relocation/transition stipend (pro-rated, one-time)

Background: Arjun is senior LLM infra engineer (ex-Quasar AI). Strong infra + quantization experience; this hire is prioritized for the inference runtime roadmap (low latency kernel work). Recruiting recommends exception given competition and the candidate’s counter.

I attached the candidate resume and a quick offer summary. Can you advise on whether Redwood can approve the combined package (sign-on + accelerated vesting) and whether headcount/budget will cover this?

Candidate contact: Arjun Rao <arjun@quasar.ai> — he asked to keep timelines tight.

Thanks —
Samantha Blake
Senior Recruiter, TalentMatch
(samantha@talentmatch.com)

Attachment: offer_summary.pdf (stub), candidate_resume.pdf (stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Blake <samantha@talentmatch.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate acceptance — request for sign-on + accelerated vesting

Tessa / Evelyn / Laura —

Looping you in to get a quick decision. Recruiting recommends we move quickly on Arjun given impact area (inference kernels) and risk of losing him to competing offer. Summary of asks: $20k sign-on, $5k transition stipend, 25% one-time early vesting. I attached a comp approval worksheet with proposed cost breakdown (base, sign-on, equity, opex cost center).

Two operational questions I need answered before we confirm to candidate:
- Do we have an open FTE headcount in the Inference org to hire now? (If not, can we reallocate a pending IC headcount?)
- Can People Ops/Comp sign off on the upfront vesting structure (one-time 25%) or suggest a capped alternative?

If we get green light today I’ll ask recruiting to send a final offer and DocuSign link. Candidate wants to close by Friday.

Thanks —
Marcus
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: comp_approval_sheet.xlsx (stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate acceptance — request for sign-on + accelerated vesting

Marcus / Tessa / Laura —

Thanks for the summary. A few notes from Comp & Rewards:

- Band checks: the role maps to Band 5 (Staff/Principal IC band). Base offer is within band but the total cash with a $20k sign-on would push comp above midpoint but still within the approved band ceiling for market exceptions.
- Sign-on: We can approve up to $15k sign-on without exec escalation. Anything above $15k requires VP approval and justification.
- Early vesting: 25% at start is uncommon. We can do a capped early-vesting of 12.5% upfront (one-time) provided we document retention conditions (12-month clawback on the 12.5% if they leave within 12 months). For anything larger (>=20%), this needs a Finance + VP sign-off.
- Relocation/transition stipend: $5k is fine as a one-time taxable stipend and can be approved by People Ops.

Please provide a short candidate justification memo (3 bullets) that we can include in the exec note if we need VP sign-off (time to fill / impact on project / competing offers). Also confirm the cost center and whether we have the open headcount (FTE ID).

If you can get me the memo and the cost center by EOD, I can route the request for a $20k sign-on / 25% vesting escalation to the VP — note the VP response timeline may be 24–48 hours.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Total Rewards Partner
Redwood Inference

Bcc: Samantha Blake <samantha@talentmatch.com>

Team —

I confirmed with Finance and Talent Planning: we have an approved headcount (FTE-2027-034) in Inference and the cost center 420-PLT is the one to charge. Finance is willing to absorb a one-time sign-on up to $20k for high-priority hires, but final approval for sign-on > $15k must come from VP Product (Per the comp guidance Evelyn noted).

Given the risk and the role priority, I recommend we:
- Approve $15k sign-on immediately (People Ops can issue payment)
- Approve $5k relocation stipend
- Approve 12.5% early vesting with 12-month clawback in the grant agreement

Action items:
- Marcus: please prepare a 3-bullet justification for VP sign-off if you want to escalate for the extra $5k sign-on or increased early vesting (state competing offer timeline and candidate specific impact).
- Evelyn: route the VP note if escalation requested (VP Product: Nina Patel).
- Recruiting (Samantha): send offer with the approved terms and include DocuSign link.

I generated a DocuSign packet placeholder while we wait: https://docusign.redwood.ai/0f9a3b-accelerated-vesting (internal). Once you confirm escalation/no-escalation, recruiting can finalize.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
